name: RISC-16
description: A load/store machine in the RISC style: eight registers R0-R7 in a register file, three register instructions such as ADD R0, R1, R2, memory reached only by LDR and STR, and calls that keep the return address in a register with BL R7, label and BX R7.

programs.name: Hello, world on the LCD
programs.description: A print subroutine called with BL R7 and left with BX R7, walking the string with LDR

programs.name: Fibonacci on the LCD
programs.description: ADD R0, R1, R2 makes each term without disturbing the two before it; stops on the carry

programs.name: Colour gradient on the screen
programs.description: Red left to right, green top to bottom

programs.name: Sketch with the arrow keys
programs.description: Reads the keypad once with IN R0 and tests each key with ANDI R4, R0, n, which leaves R0 alone
